status: candidate frozen references; derived by two exact formulations that agree, not yet independently refuted
theory: small-displacement linear-elastic space frame, Euler-Bernoulli straight members, homogeneous isotropic; exact pressure route: uniform internal differential p per region, EA eps = N_w - 2 nu p A_i on each member of a pressurized region, a cap -p A_i s at each transfers_to_wall terminal (s from the node into the member), no follower pressure, no Bourdon rotation, no pressure stiffening
section_bases: D-5: stiffness (A, I, J) and A_s in the free elongation on the nominal wall t; reduced wall t_r = (t - c_m) - c_a; r_o = D/2 for both; pressure bore r_i,r = D/2 - t_r, A_i = pi r_i,r^2

conventions.support_reaction: global action of the support on the structure at its node (moments about that node)
conventions.member_end_action: action of the node on the member at that end, in member axes (x from `from` to `to`, y the y_reference less its x part, z = x cross y); the axial component is -N_w at the `from` end and +N_w at the `to` end (tension positive), i.e. the physical wall force
conventions.wall_axial_force: N_w, the wall's axial force, tension positive
conventions.effective_axial_force: N_el = N_w - p A_i (the effective force; N_el = N_w outside a pressure region)
conventions.mechanical_axial_force: N_m = E A_n eps, so N_w = N_m + 2 nu p A_i
conventions.tee_intensified_bending_stress: i hypot(My, Mz) / Z_basis at the referenced member end at the tee node (member-axis bending moments; torsion and axial force excluded); published through its exact square
conventions.exact_text: a sum of terms q, q*pi, q*pi^k, q/pi or q/pi^k with q rational, joined by ' + '; a square root is 'sqrt(<exact>)' and carries exact_square
conventions.decimal: 40 significant digits; value is the nearest binary64

criterion_proposed: |observed - expected| <= 1e-9 * |expected|; an exactly zero expectation uses 1e-9 * zero_scale of its family (largest nonzero magnitude of that family in the case, or the stated fallback); the product binding chooses its own criterion
